/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
p='assets/data/career_path.db'
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro', uri=True)
ids=[1,2,3,21,24,26,28,30,31,32,33,34,42,43,46,47,50,51,63,66,68,69,71,80,81,88,90,93,103,127,146,153,165,166,167,175,177,178,198,208,210,211,213,214,217,267,283,308,309,311,312,313,330,333,335,336,337,338,339,340,341,342,343,344,347,348,350,356,365,369,376,379]
rows=con.execute('select id,slug,stream_id,parent_id,name from career_nodes').fetchall()
by={r[0]:r for r in rows}
streams={r[0]:r[2] for r in con.execute('select id,slug,name from streams')}
for i in ids:
    if i not in by: continue
    chain=[]; cur=i
    while cur is not None:
        r=by[cur]; chain.append(r[4]); cur=r[3]
    chain=list(reversed(chain))
    sid=by[i][2]
    prefix=streams.get(sid)
    if prefix and (not chain or chain[0]"'!=prefix): chain=[prefix]+chain
    print(f'"'{i}\\t{by[i][1]}\\t{by[i][4]}\\t{\" > \".join(chain)}')
PY"
